metadata.name: asset_registry
metadata.description: Mancipatio asset registry — issuers, assets, share classes, KYC (Faza 1)

instructions.name: accept_issuer_authority
docs: The proposed key accepts; the old grant's capabilities move to it.

accounts.name: old_permissions
docs: The outgoing authority's grant, closed here when present (rent to the
acceptor); its capabilities move to `new_permissions`.
validated by `util::take_old_grant`. It may not exist.

accounts.name: old_admin_record
docs: The outgoing authority's global Admin PDA (usually missing).

accounts.name: new_admin_record
docs: The incoming key's global Admin PDA (usually missing).

accounts.name: recovery
docs: The issuer's pending recovery, retired here when present (it may not exist).

instructions.name: accept_kyc_registry_authority
docs: The proposed authority accepts the KYC registry.

accounts.name: old_admin_record
docs: It may be unresolved on an older deployment that revoked its own role.

instructions.name: activate_asset
docs: Activates a `Draft` asset once its share classes are configured
(admin). Minting and primary sales require an active asset.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may activate assets.

instructions.name: add_admin
docs: Super admin grants the admin role to `new_admin`.

instructions.name: add_share_class
docs: Adds a sequential share class to a draft asset.

instructions.name: add_vesting_position
docs: Adds a recipient position (wallet + allocation) — only while Draft.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The client — series authority.

instructions.name: approve_holder
docs: Records an approved (time-bounded) holder in a KYC registry. The
registry is taken by address and gated by `has_one = authority`.

accounts.name: kyc_registry
docs: Taken BY ADDRESS, not re-derived from the signer: a registry's address
is fixed at creation (`["kyc_registry", creating authority]`) while its
`authority` can rotate. `Account<KycRegistry>` still checks the owner
and discriminator, and only `create_kyc_registry` (admin co-signed) can
create one, so it cannot be forged.

accounts.name: kyc_entry
docs: `init_if_needed` — first approval creates the entry; a later call for
the same holder RE-approves it in place (after a revoke or an expiry),
overwriting every field with the fresh KYC decision.

instructions.name: approve_sale
docs: Admin approval to open exactly one sale (`share_class`, `sale_id`),
bounded by payment mint, price range, maximum gross raise, raise type,
Startup payout schedule (cliff / vesting months) and expiry (at most 90
days). Consumed by `open_sale`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The approving Admin; pays the approval's rent and becomes `approved_by`.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate: only a platform Admin may approve a sale.

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: The payment mint the approved sale must use (validated in the handler
with the same payment-leg rule `open_sale` applies to its escrow).

accounts.name: sale
docs: The future `Sale` PDA for this id. It must still be empty, so the
approval can actually be consumed.

instructions.name: approve_vesting_tranche
docs: Approves one tranche (Approval-mode series). Approval delays but can
never freeze a vested tranche past its approval window.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The client — series authority.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buys share-class units from an open sale — pay, then receive minted units.

accounts.name: buyer_share_account
docs: Buyer's share-class token account — receives the purchased units.
Bound to the buyer signer so the receiver of the minted security is the
party whose KYC is checked in the handler — units can never be
redirected to an arbitrary third-party account (mirrors `take_offer`).

accounts.name: buyer_payment_account
docs: Buyer's payment token account — debited the price.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: cancel_issuer_authority_transfer
docs: The current issuer authority cancels a pending proposal.

instructions.name: cancel_issuer_recovery
docs: The current issuer authority or the super admin cancels a recovery.

accounts.name: canceller
docs: The live issuer authority or the live super admin. Not `mut`: it may be
the same key as `proposer`.

instructions.name: cancel_kyc_registry_authority_transfer
docs: The current KYC registry authority cancels a pending proposal.

instructions.name: cancel_offer
docs: Cancels an open OTC offer — escrowed units return to the maker.

accounts.name: maker
docs: Mut: receives the closed escrow marker's rent.

accounts.name: maker_share_account
docs: Maker reclaims the escrowed share units here — bound to the maker so the
refund cannot be redirected through the escrow-marker exemption to an
arbitrary (e.g. non-KYC) account (mirrors `expire_offer`).

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the offer PDA — closed here (rent → maker);
cancel is a terminal path.

instructions.name: cancel_otc_deal
docs: Cancels an open OTC deal (admin) — deposited funds return to the
respective party.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Mut: receives the closed escrow marker's rent.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may cancel an OTC deal.

accounts.name: seller_share_account
docs: The seller reclaims the escrowed share units here.

accounts.name: buyer_payment_account
docs: The buyer reclaims the escrowed payment here.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the deal PDA — closed here (rent → authority);
cancel is a terminal path.

instructions.name: cancel_vesting_series
docs: Cancels the series (cancellation-enabled only): vested stays the
recipient's forever, only the unvested remainder returns.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The client — series authority.

instructions.name: cast_vault_vote
docs: Casts an investor's weighted vote on a VaultVote; Merkle-proves membership
in the snapshot and blocks double-voting via the record PDA.

instructions.name: cast_vote
docs: Casts a weighted advisory vote, proven against the snapshot Merkle root.

accounts.name: vote_record
docs: One vote per voter — `init` fails on a second vote.

instructions.name: claim_founder_yield
docs: Founder withdraws their accumulated yield from the vault escrow; resets
`founder_yield_claimable` to 0. Fails with `NothingToClaim` if balance
is zero. Gated by `has_one = founder` on the vault.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: claim_investor_yield
docs: Investor proves Merkle membership in the investor yield snapshot and
withdraws their pro-rata share of `investor_yield_pool`. Cumulative:
entitlement = `weight * investor_yield_pool / total_weight`; the investor
can re-claim the delta as the pool grows with each `route_yield`.

instructions.name: claim_milestone
docs: Claims a holder's entitlement from a vesting milestone.

accounts.name: claim
docs: One claim per (milestone, claimer) — `init` fails on a second claim.

accounts.name: claimer_token_account
docs: Claimer receives the underlying tokens here — bound to the `claimer`
signer, whose key IS the entitlement proven against the milestone root.
Without the owner bind the escrow→destination leg could be pointed at
any third-party account: `publish_milestone` takes an arbitrary
`merkle_root`, so an admin plus one accomplice could route the escrow
into a permissionlessly created `Offer` escrow (owner = `Offer` PDA,
which carries an `EscrowMarker` — the hook's destination-marker
exemption skips receiver KYC there) and `cancel_offer` the balance out
to a wallet with no `KycEntry`. Mirrors `buy` / `take_offer`.

instructions.name: claim_refund
docs: After a vault is Cancelled (ReturnCapital vote), each investor reclaims
their pro-rata share of the remaining principal, proven by Merkle
membership in the vote's snapshot. Idempotent — ClaimRecord tracks
cumulative drawn.

instructions.name: claim_vested
docs: Claim-mode release — the recipient pulls their vested amount.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: The recipient — must be the wallet currently recorded on the position.

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: The recipient's token account — must be owned by the position's wallet.

instructions.name: clawback_blocklisted_holder
docs: Admin claws back the units of a holder on the transfer-hook blocklist
into a burn-only quarantine escrow (a `RedemptionQueue` +
`BurnAndAttest` custody vault of the same share class) via the mint's
`PermanentDelegate`. `Open` or `KycGated` mints; two keys — the holder
must carry a live hook `BlockEntry` (created only by the hook's
BlocklistAuthority) and an Admin signs. `amount == 0` sweeps the
holder's full balance.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — the signer must hold an `Admin` record. This is the second
key; the first is the BlocklistAuthority that created `block_entry`.

accounts.name: holder_share_account
docs: Any token account of this mint owned by `holder` — the clawback source.
The hook independently re-derives its `BlockEntry` from this account's
owner, so the evidence chain is `source.owner == holder ==
BlockEntry.wallet`.

accounts.name: holder_escrow_marker
docs: Proof that `holder` is an ordinary wallet and not one of this program's
own escrows (`EscrowMarker` / `EscrowIdentity` at this address). The
BlocklistAuthority can block ANY pubkey, escrow PDAs included, so even
with both keys a program escrow cannot be targeted — see
`clawback_from_holder` for the full reasoning.

accounts.name: block_entry
docs: The holder's transfer-hook `BlockEntry` PDA `["blocked", holder]` —
the first key. Only the hook's `BlocklistAuthority` can create it.
discriminator, wallet) checked by `util::require_blocklisted`.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Destination — the escrow of `custody_vault` below (burn-only quarantine
of THIS share class).

accounts.name: custody_vault
docs: The quarantine vault — identical constraints to `clawback_from_holder`:
a typed, Active `RedemptionQueue` + `BurnAndAttest` `CustodyVault` of
this class whose every exit burns.

accounts.name: hook_config
docs: The mint's `TransferHookConfig` PDA (`["hook_cfg", mint]` under the
hook), in ANY mode — it tells the handler whether the mint is KycGated.
checks it is hook-owned and names this mint and share class.

instructions.name: clawback_from_holder
docs: Admin claws back a revoked (or KYC-expired) holder's share units into a
burn-only quarantine escrow (a `RedemptionQueue` + `BurnAndAttest`
custody vault of the same share class) via the mint's
`PermanentDelegate` (the ShareClass PDA signs). `KycGated` mints only —
the registry is pinned to the one the mint's hook config names.
`amount == 0` sweeps the holder's full balance.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — the signer must hold an `Admin` record.

accounts.name: holder_share_account
docs: The holder's share token account — the clawback source. The `ShareClass`
PDA is the mint's Token-2022 `PermanentDelegate` (set at mint creation),
so no holder signature is needed.

accounts.name: holder_escrow_marker
docs: Proof that `holder` is an ordinary wallet and not one of this program's
own escrows. `holder` is a free parameter and `approve_holder` mints a
`KycEntry` for ANY pubkey, PDAs included — so without this an admin
could approve→revoke an Offer / OtcDeal / CustodyVault PDA and "claw
back" its balance into a burn vault, destroying the ledgered deposit of
a fully compliant maker, seller or beneficiary. Every such escrow
carries an `EscrowMarker` or `EscrowIdentity` at this address, so an INITIALISED account
here means the target is program-held property. The address is derived
by Anchor, so the caller can neither omit nor substitute it; the
constraint demands it be empty (never opened, or already closed).

accounts.name: destination
docs: Destination — the escrow of `custody_vault` below, i.e. a burn-only
quarantine escrow of THIS share class. The vault PDA owns it and carries
an `EscrowMarker`, so the hook's destination-marker exemption keeps the
clawback leg from ever being blocked by receiver-KYC.

accounts.name: custody_vault
docs: The quarantine vault the seized units land in — a typed, admin-opened
`CustodyVault` of this share class, restricted to the one vault shape
whose every exit BURNS: `RedemptionQueue` + `BurnAndAttest`
(`realize_custody_vault` burns, `revert_custody_vault` burns, and
`return_custody_vault` — the only escrow→wallet exit — is reserved for
`DeliveryEscrow` vaults and therefore unreachable here). An
`EscrowMarker` alone would NOT be containment: `create_offer` mints one
permissionlessly and `cancel_offer` pays the full escrow balance back to
the maker's wallet.

accounts.name: kyc_registry
docs: Registry the holder's entry is checked against — pinned by the handler
to the registry the mint's hook config points at (clawback is only
allowed on `KycGated` mints, so the pin always applies).

accounts.name: kyc_entry
docs: The holder's KYC entry — must be `Revoked` or expired (see handler).

accounts.name: hook_config
docs: the transfer_hook program) — address enforced by the seeds constraint;
the handler reads `restriction_mode` / `kyc_registry` by offset
(layout mirrored in constants.rs, no crate dependency on the hook).
Must exist and say `KycGated`: on an `Open` mint there is no registry
to pin `kyc_registry` to, so the whole instruction is refused.

instructions.name: close_distribution
docs: Closes a distribution (admin) — the undistributed remainder is swept
to the refund account.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Mut: receives the closed escrow marker's rent.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may close distributions.

accounts.name: refund_account
docs: Receives the undistributed remainder — must be owned by the wallet
that funded the distribution (`distribution.funder`).

accounts.name: escrow_rent_recipient
docs: closed — constrained to be the distribution funder (the wallet that
owns `refund_account`), so both the remainder and the rent return to
whoever funded the distribution.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the distribution PDA — closed here (rent →
authority); close is the distribution's only terminal path.

instructions.name: close_sale
docs: Closes a sale and sweeps proceeds to the issuer.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Issuer's payment account — receives the collected proceeds.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: create_asset
docs: Creates a `Draft` asset under a KYB-verified issuer.

instructions.name: create_distribution
docs: Opens a push-based pro-rata revenue distribution for a share class
(admin; business-doc §2–§5) and funds its escrow atomically.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may open distributions.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Share-class mint the distribution relates to (indexing only).

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: Payment mint being distributed (e.g. USDT).

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow holding the payment tokens; authority is the `Distribution` PDA.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Marks the distribution PDA as a platform escrow authority — the
transfer hook exempts escrow legs from receiver-KYC while this exists.
Closed by `close_distribution`.

accounts.name: funder
docs: Funds the distribution — transfers exactly `total_amount` into the
escrow. Recorded on the `Distribution`; `close_distribution` refunds
the remainder (and the escrow's rent) to this wallet.

accounts.name: funder_payment_account
docs: Funder's payment token account — debited `total_amount`.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: create_kyc_registry
docs: Creates a KYC registry owned by a KYC-provider authority, co-signed by
a platform admin. The address `["kyc_registry", authority]` is fixed
forever; the authority itself can later rotate.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The KYC provider the registry belongs to — pays for and owns it, and is
the only signer `approve_holder` / `revoke_holder` accept afterwards,
until rotated (`propose_kyc_registry_authority` /
`accept_kyc_registry_authority`). The registry address stays derived
from THIS creating key forever, so this key can never create a second
registry, even after rotating the first one away.

accounts.name: admin_authority
docs: Platform admin co-signer. Registries are the root of trust for every
`KycGated` mint, so one cannot be conjured permissionlessly. The
co-signature gates only the CREATION of the address: afterwards the
current registry authority alone rotates the registry (to any key,
including an admin key) and replaces its jurisdiction bitmaps, with no
admin co-signature, admin override or pause flag. The registry
authority gets no admin powers from this record.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — `admin_authority` must hold an `Admin` record.

instructions.name: create_offer
docs: Opens an OTC sell offer for share-class units (Faza 3).
`expires_at` = unix ts after which the offer is takeable no more
(0 = never expires).

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: Payment mint the taker will pay in.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow for the maker's deposited share units; authority is the `Offer` PDA.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Marks the offer PDA as a platform escrow authority — the transfer hook
exempts escrow legs from receiver-KYC while this exists. Closed on
every terminal path (take / cancel / expire).
NOTE: the marker is a ROUTING fact (an escrow PDA can never hold a
`KycEntry`), not a statement that whatever leaves this escrow may go
anywhere. Because `create_offer` is permissionless and the escrow is an
ordinary token account, anyone can push units into it — so every exit
decides for itself, against `offer.deposited`.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: create_otc_deal
docs: Opens a bilateral OTC escrow deal between a named buyer and seller
(admin; business-doc §9). `expires_at` = unix ts after which the deal
can no longer be deposited into (0 = never expires).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may create OTC deals (the platform opens the
deal after the parties have agreed off-chain).

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: Payment mint the buyer will pay in (plain SPL or Token-2022).

accounts.name: asset_escrow
docs: Escrow for the seller's deposited share units; authority is the deal PDA.

accounts.name: payment_escrow
docs: Escrow for the buyer's deposited payment; authority is the deal PDA.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Marks the deal PDA as a platform escrow authority — the transfer hook
exempts escrow legs from receiver-KYC while this exists. Closed on
every terminal path (settle / cancel / expire).

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: create_proposal
docs: Opens an advisory governance proposal for a share class (Faza 4).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may open a governance proposal.

instructions.name: create_rights_issuance
docs: Opens a Rights-Token vesting issuance (Faza 5).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may open a Rights-Token issuance.

accounts.name: share_class
docs: The Rights-Token share class whose holders the underlying vests to.

accounts.name: underlying_mint
docs: The underlying token to be delivered to Rights-Token holders.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow holding the underlying tokens; authority is the `RightsIssuance` PDA.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: create_vesting_series
docs: Creates a client-owned vesting series — schedule and settings fixed at
creation (timing/delivery mode, approval window, recovery,
cancellation, pre-cliff %). No admin gate: every series authority sits
with the client, and Mancipatio holds no key over the escrow.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The client — series authority (approval / recovery / cancellation).
Mancipatio holds NO key over the escrow: there is no admin gate here;
the platform's review happens off-chain before the client is shown
the creation form.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: Supported SPL / Token-2022 mint; extension policy is enforced before creation.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Escrow holding the deposited tokens; authority is the series PDA.

instructions.name: deposit_otc_asset
docs: Seller deposits the share units into the deal's asset escrow; if the
payment is already escrowed, the swap settles atomically.

accounts.name: seller_share_account
docs: Seller's share-class token account — debited exactly `deal.amount`.

accounts.name: buyer_share_account
docs: Buyer receives the share units here if this deposit completes the pair.

accounts.name: seller_payment_account
docs: Seller receives the payment here if this deposit completes the pair.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the deal PDA — closed (rent → seller) when this
deposit completes the pair and the swap settles.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: deposit_otc_payment
docs: Buyer deposits the payment into the deal's payment escrow; if the
asset is already escrowed, the swap settles atomically.

accounts.name: buyer_payment_account
docs: Buyer's payment token account — debited exactly `deal.price`.

accounts.name: buyer_share_account
docs: Buyer receives the share units here if this deposit completes the pair.

accounts.name: seller_payment_account
docs: Seller receives the payment here if this deposit completes the pair.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the deal PDA — closed (rent → buyer) when this
deposit completes the pair and the swap settles.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: deposit_to_custody_vault
docs: Funds an `Active` custody vault's escrow from the depositor's own
wallet and CREDITS the vault's deposit ledger. For a `DeliveryEscrow`
the depositor must be the vault's `beneficiary` — the ledger is what
lets `return_custody_vault` refund them without a receiver-KYC check.

accounts.name: depositor
docs: The depositing holder — signs the escrow-funding `transfer_checked`.
For a `DeliveryEscrow` vault this MUST be the vault's `beneficiary`
(checked in the handler): the ledger this instruction writes is the
evidence `return_custody_vault` uses to release units KYC-free, so it
may only ever record the beneficiary's own units.

accounts.name: depositor_share_account
docs: The depositor's share-class token account — debited exactly `amount`.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: deposit_to_offer_escrow
docs: Funds an open offer's escrow from the maker's own wallet and CREDITS
`offer.deposited`. The maker must sign; this is the only route that
makes the escrow balance provably theirs, and it is what lets
`cancel_offer` / `expire_offer` refund them without a receiver-KYC
check (and what stops `take_offer` selling somebody else's units).

accounts.name: maker
docs: The offer's maker — the only party whose units this ledger may record,
and the only party the refund paths pay out to.

accounts.name: maker_share_account
docs: The maker's share-class token account — debited exactly `amount`.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: deposit_to_vesting_escrow
docs: Deposits tokens into the series escrow; releases are blocked until
deposits cover the full allocation.

accounts.name: depositor
docs: The depositing wallet — signs the escrow-funding transfer. Usually the
client; anyone may top a series up.

accounts.name: depositor_token_account
docs: The depositor's token account — debited exactly `amount`.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: disable_vesting_cancellation
docs: Irrevocably turns cancellation OFF (never the reverse).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The client — series authority.

instructions.name: distribute_batch
docs: Pushes a batch of pro-rata payouts from the distribution escrow
(admin); one `YieldPaid` event per payout.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: receipt replay may arrive after close_distribution closed this account.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: execute_issuer_recovery
docs: The recovered key executes a recovery once its timelock has passed.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The recovered key signs. Not `mut`: the old grant's and the recovery's
rent both go to `proposer`, so this key needs no balance.

accounts.name: old_permissions
docs: The lost authority's grant, closed when present (rent to `proposer`).

accounts.name: new_permissions
docs: A leftover grant of the RECOVERED key, closed when present (rent to
`proposer`): a recovery never carries capabilities, so none may revive.

accounts.name: new_admin_record
docs: The recovered key's global Admin PDA: a recovery never lands on one.

accounts.name: transfer
docs: The issuer's pending regular rotation, retired here when present (it may not exist).

instructions.name: expire_offer
docs: Expires an open OTC offer past its `expires_at` — permissionless;
escrowed units return to the maker.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Permissionless after `expires_at` — any signer may pay the fee.
Mut: receives the closed escrow marker's rent.

accounts.name: maker_share_account
docs: The maker reclaims the escrowed share units here.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the offer PDA — closed here (rent → payer);
expiry is a terminal path.

instructions.name: expire_otc_deal
docs: Expires an open OTC deal past its `expires_at` — permissionless;
deposited funds return to the respective party.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Permissionless after `expires_at` — any signer may pay the fee.
Mut: receives the closed escrow marker's rent.

accounts.name: seller_share_account
docs: The seller reclaims the escrowed share units here.

accounts.name: buyer_payment_account
docs: The buyer reclaims the escrowed payment here.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the deal PDA — closed here (rent → payer);
expiry is a terminal path.

instructions.name: finalize_proposal
docs: Finalizes a proposal after its voting window — advisory outcome.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Permissionless after the voting window — any signer pays the fee.

instructions.name: finalize_vault_vote
docs: Finalises a vault vote after the window ends; ReturnCapital majority
cancels the vault (enables refunds), otherwise Extend resumes it and
shifts the schedule forward past overdue periods.

instructions.name: finalize_vesting_series
docs: Finalizes a complete Draft before its first unlock, permanently fixing allocations.

instructions.name: freeze_vault
docs: Permissionless: freezes an Active vault when the founder is ≥3
update-periods overdue (i.e. periods_elapsed − updates_posted ≥ 3).

instructions.name: initialize_platform
docs: Creates the platform singleton. The signer becomes the platform admin.

accounts.name: super_admin_record
docs: The super admin is also admin #1 — every privileged instruction requires
an `Admin` record, so the super admin needs one to operate.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: Deployment authority authorizes the initial operational administrator.

instructions.name: initialize_share_class_mint
docs: Creates the Token-2022 mint for a share class (TransferHook extension
wired to the `transfer_hook` program; on-chain metadata via the
MetadataPointer + TokenMetadata extensions).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Global Admin or issuer-local MINT capability; the signer must also be the issuer.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Token-2022 mint for this share class — a PDA, with the `ShareClass` PDA
as mint authority. TransferHook extension wired to the Mancipatio
`transfer_hook` program. No `DefaultAccountState=Frozen` — custody, not
freeze (docs/01 §6).

accounts.name: hook_config
docs: (`["hook_cfg", mint]` under the transfer_hook program) — created by the
hook program via CPI; that program enforces the seeds, and the handler
additionally checks the derived address.

accounts.name: extra_account_meta_list
docs: (`["extra-account-metas", mint]` under the transfer_hook program) —
created by the hook program via CPI; same validation as `hook_config`.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: lock_supply
docs: Locks a share class's supply — closes minting (admin; audit finding M3).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may lock a share class's supply.

instructions.name: mint_to_treasury
docs: Mints share-class units into a destination token account (Token-2022
CPI signed by the `ShareClass` PDA).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Global Admin or issuer-local MINT capability; the signer must also be the issuer.
The treasury destination (the signer's own token account) additionally
requires the global Admin record: MINT alone only funds the admin-created
custody / rights escrows.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Destination token account — receives the freshly minted units. Bound in
the handler: owned by the signing issuer authority (the treasury) or the
escrow of an `Active` burn-only `CustodyVault` / a `RightsIssuance` of
this very mint (proven by deserializing that account, not by its owner
program — and, for a vault, by its exit shape).

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: open_custody_vault
docs: Opens a custody vault (`Active`) with an empty escrow token account.
A `DeliveryEscrow` pins a `KycRegistry` (optional account, required for
that type and refused for every other) that its realize checks the
beneficiary in (2C-3).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — only an admin may open custody vaults.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: Token-2022 escrow account holding the custodied tokens; authority is the
`CustodyVault` PDA.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Marks the vault PDA as a platform escrow authority — the transfer hook
exempts escrow legs from receiver-KYC while this exists. Closed on
every terminal path (realize / revert / return).

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only), checked in the handler: a burn-only
quarantine vault (RedemptionQueue + BurnAndAttest) stays openable for
clawback. Appended after the original accounts (old account indices
keep their positions); only `kyc_registry` (2C-3) follows it.

accounts.name: kyc_registry
docs: DeliveryEscrow: REQUIRED — the registry `realize_custody_vault` checks
the beneficiary's `KycEntry` in (pinned on the vault). Any other type:
must be None (the program-id placeholder). `Account<KycRegistry>`
checks owner + discriminator, and only `create_kyc_registry` (admin
co-signed) can create one. Appended LAST (2C-3): no index moves.

instructions.name: open_payout_vault
docs: Closes a Startup sale, sweeps proceeds into a payout vault escrow,
and initialises the monthly tranche schedule.

instructions.name: open_sale
docs: Opens a primary sale of a share class (launchpad), consuming the
Admin's `SaleApproval` for this `(share_class, sale_id)`. The approver
must still be an Admin; the sale must start by the approval's expiry
and use its exact payout schedule.

accounts.name: payment_mint
docs: Payment mint buyers pay in (e.g. USDC).

accounts.name: proceeds
docs: Proceeds escrow (payment mint) — authority is the `Sale` PDA.

accounts.name: sale_approval
docs: The Admin's approval for exactly this `(share_class, sale_id)` (the
seeds bind both). Consumed here: closed, rent to `approved_by`.

accounts.name: approved_by
docs: The approving Admin (`sale_approval.approved_by`); receives the consumed
approval's rent. May be the same key as `authority`.

accounts.name: approver_admin_record
docs: The approver's Admin record: an approval dies with its approver's Admin
role (`remove_admin`, or a super-admin rotation, closes the record), so
a removed or compromised key's approvals cannot be used.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: open_vault_vote
docs: Opens an investor vote on a Frozen vault with a Merkle snapshot root.
Sets the total investor weight (set-once) on the vault for later pro-rata
refund calculations.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — the signer must hold an `Admin` record.

instructions.name: post_update
docs: Posts a monthly update from the founder; gated on the period start
timestamp to prevent pre-posting all updates up front.

instructions.name: prepare_legacy_account
docs: Registers an issuer in `Pending` KYB state.

accounts.name: legacy_account
docs: are validated below before resizing. No arbitrary program account write.

instructions.name: propose_issuer_authority
docs: The current issuer authority proposes a new authority (regular rotation).

instructions.name: propose_issuer_recovery
docs: The super admin proposes recovering a lost issuer key, executable after
a 7-day timelock.

instructions.name: propose_kyc_registry_authority
docs: The current KYC registry authority proposes a new authority. The
registry ADDRESS never changes; only `authority` rotates on accept.

instructions.name: publish_milestone
docs: Publishes a vesting milestone with its claim snapshot Merkle root.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: push_vested
docs: Push-mode release — anyone may trigger delivery to the position's
current wallet.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone — pays for the delivery. Permissionless by design: in Push mode
the contract releases on schedule without depending on the client, the
recipient, or Mancipatio (spec §11.1.8, §11.1.11).

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: The recipient's token account — owned by the position's CURRENT wallet
(recovery re-points delivery).

instructions.name: realize_custody_vault
docs: Realizes a `Triggered` custody vault (v0.1: burn escrow + attest event).
For a `DeliveryEscrow` (conversion / delivery) the beneficiary must hold
an Approved, unexpired, jurisdiction-allowed `KycEntry` in the vault's
pinned registry; without it the exit is `return_custody_vault`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Mut: receives the closed escrow marker's rent.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the vault PDA — closed here (rent → authority);
realize is a terminal path.

accounts.name: kyc_registry
docs: DeliveryEscrow only: the registry pinned at open
(`custody_vault.kyc_registry`). Ignored for every other type. Appended
LAST (2C-3).

accounts.name: kyc_entry
docs: DeliveryEscrow only: the beneficiary's entry,
`["kyc", kyc_registry, custody_vault.beneficiary]` — checked in the
handler (no Anchor seeds, so clients never auto-fill a non-existent
entry and each failure keeps its own error). Ignored otherwise.

instructions.name: recover_issuer_registration
docs: Recovers a Pending/Rejected legal-ID reservation with no existing assets.

instructions.name: recover_vesting_position
docs: Re-points a position to a replacement wallet (recovery-enabled series
only) — same recipient, new address.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The client — series authority. Recovery authority sits with the
CLIENT, not with Mancipatio (spec §11.1.10); confirming that the
replacement wallet belongs to the same person is the client's own
off-chain verification process.

instructions.name: release_payout
docs: Releases the next due tranche to the founder; gated on tranche time AND
an update posted for that tranche's period. Startup vaults only.

accounts.name: founder_account
docs: Founder's payment account — receives the tranche. Must belong to vault.founder.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: remove_admin
docs: Super admin revokes the admin role from `admin`.

instructions.name: return_custody_vault
docs: Returns a `DeliveryEscrow` vault's escrowed tokens to the beneficiary
(no burn). Authority at any time; anyone once the deadline has passed.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Vault authority with a live Admin role at any time (`Active`/`Triggered`); anyone
once a positive `deadline` has passed (`deadline == 0` — the only
non-positive value `open_custody_vault` accepts — disables the
permissionless path). Mut: receives the closed escrow marker's rent.

accounts.name: beneficiary_token_account
docs: The beneficiary receives the escrowed tokens back here.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the vault PDA. Closed by the handler (rent → signer)
ONLY when the escrow is fully drained — a return that had to withhold an
un-releasable surplus leaves the vault (and this marker) alive so the
remainder still has an exit. Closed manually rather than with
`close = signer` for exactly that reason.

instructions.name: revert_custody_vault
docs: Reverts an `Active` custody vault after its deadline (escape hatch).
Forbidden for `DeliveryEscrow` vaults — use `return_custody_vault`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The vault `authority`, or — once a POSITIVE `deadline` has passed —
anyone (`deadline == 0` disables the permissionless path, mirroring
`return_custody_vault`). Mut: receives the closed escrow marker's rent.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the vault PDA — closed here (rent → payer);
revert is a terminal path.

instructions.name: revoke_holder
docs: Revokes a holder's KYC entry — flips status to `Revoked`.
The `transfer_hook` program checks only the RECEIVER, so a revoked
holder can no longer receive — but keeps (and can still send) their
balance. Use `clawback_from_holder` to seize it (or, for a wallet the
hook's BlocklistAuthority has blocked, `clawback_blocklisted_holder`).

accounts.name: kyc_registry
docs: Taken by address (see `ApproveHolder::kyc_registry`): the registry
address is permanent, its `authority` rotates.

instructions.name: revoke_sale_approval
docs: Closes an unused sale approval (any Admin; rent to the approver).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate: any active Admin may revoke, not only the approver.

accounts.name: approved_by
docs: The approving Admin; receives the approval's rent, whoever revokes.

instructions.name: route_yield
docs: Admin deposits `amount` of payment-token yield and splits it 3-ways:
founder third + investor third stay in vault escrow; platform third is
transferred immediately to the platform treasury. Sets the investor
cap-table root and total_weight (set-once) for later `claim_investor_yield`.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Admin gate — the signer must hold an `Admin` record.

accounts.name: source
docs: Distributor's payment-token source account (authority-owned).

accounts.name: platform_treasury
docs: Platform treasury — receives its third immediately.

instructions.name: set_convertible_to
docs: Sets or clears a share class's conversion target (admin + issuer
authority double gate). Pass `target_share_class` to set — it must be
an existing share class of the same asset and not the class itself —
or omit it to clear.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Global Admin or issuer-local CONVERSION capability; signer is also the issuer.

accounts.name: share_class
docs: The share class whose conversion target is being set.

accounts.name: target_share_class
docs: The share class this one converts into. Pass it to set the target;
omit it to clear (`convertible_to = None`). Must be an existing share
class of the SAME asset and must not be `share_class` itself.

instructions.name: set_issuer_permissions
docs: Grants/revokes issuer-local operational capabilities without global Admin.

instructions.name: set_pause
docs: Legacy onboarding switch (super admin): sets / clears only
`PAUSE_ONBOARDING`. The full emergency pause is `set_pause_flags`.

instructions.name: set_pause_flags
docs: Emergency pause: `flags = (flags | set_mask) & !clear_mask`. Any Admin
may set defined bits; only the super admin may clear.

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: `util::is_active_admin` unless `authority == platform.admin` (a super
admin without an Admin record is tolerated).

instructions.name: set_protocol_treasury
docs: Super admin rotates the protocol treasury (nonzero key).

instructions.name: sync_payout_founder
docs: Permissionless: copies the live issuer authority into `PayoutVault.founder`.

accounts.name: share_class
docs: only `asset` (byte 8) is read.

accounts.name: asset
docs: only `issuer` (byte 8) is read.

instructions.name: sync_sale_authority
docs: Permissionless: copies the live issuer authority into `Sale.authority`.

accounts.name: share_class
docs: only `asset` (byte 8) is read.

accounts.name: asset
docs: only `issuer` (byte 8) is read.

instructions.name: take_offer
docs: Fills an open OTC offer — taker pays, escrowed units are released.

accounts.name: taker_share_account
docs: Taker receives the share units here. Bound to the taker signer so the
receiver of the escrowed security is the party whose KYC is checked below
— shares can never be redirected to an arbitrary third-party account
(mirrors `expire_offer` / `deposit_otc_asset`).

accounts.name: taker_payment_account
docs: Taker pays from here.

accounts.name: maker_payment_account
docs: Maker receives the payment here.

accounts.name: escrow_marker
docs: Escrow marker for the offer PDA — closed here (rent → taker);
take is a terminal path.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Emergency-pause gate (read-only). Keep LAST among named accounts: old
account indices and the remaining-accounts hook tail keep their positions.

instructions.name: trigger_custody_vault
docs: Moves a custody vault `Active → Triggered`.

instructions.name: update_kyc_registry_jurisdictions
docs: The KYC registry authority replaces both jurisdiction bitmaps.

instructions.name: update_mint_metadata
docs: Updates the on-chain metadata of a share-class mint — only the `uri`
field may change (admin + issuer authority, ShareClass PDA signs).

accounts.name: admin_record
docs: Global Admin or issuer-local METADATA capability; signer is also the issuer.

instructions.name: verify_issuer_kyb
docs: Platform admin records the off-chain KYB decision.

instructions.name: withdraw_unvested
docs: Withdraws the unvested remainder after cancellation; the recipients'
reserved amount can never leave through here.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The client — series authority.

accounts.name: authority_token_account
docs: The client's token account — destination of the unvested remainder.

instructions.name: withdraw_vesting_surplus
docs: Withdraws only the actual excess above every unpaid Active allocation.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The client — series authority.

accounts.name: authority_token_account
docs: The client's token account — destination of the unvested remainder.

types.name: Admin
docs: Marks a Mancipatio admin — the role that may issue mints, run custody and
other privileged operations. Created/removed by the super admin.
Seeds: `["admin", admin]`.

types.name: Asset
docs: Parent container for one or more share classes.
Seeds: `["asset", issuer, asset_id]`.

fields.name: legal_doc_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain legal documentation (term sheet, prospectus…).

fields.name: extra_kyc_registry
docs: `None` = use the global KYC registry; `Some` = stricter per-issuer
registry (extra restrictions only, never a relaxation). docs/01 §9.
NOTE: Token-2022 permanent-delegate clawback is **always-on** — Mancipatio
is the permanent delegate on every share-class mint (clawback / regulatory
orders / forced delivery), applied at mint creation, not a per-asset flag
(Answers for Mladen §2).

types.name: AuthorityTransfer
docs: A staged operational authority change; no program upgrade authority changes.
Seeds: ["authority_transfer", target account].

types.name: BlocklistClawback
docs: Emitted by `clawback_blocklisted_holder` — a holder on the transfer-hook
blocklist had units seized into a burn-only quarantine vault via the mint's
permanent delegate, on an Open or a KycGated mint. The two keys behind the
seizure are both on the record: `blocked_by` (the `BlockEntry.added_by`
BlocklistAuthority key) and `admin` (the signer). Monitoring should alert
when they are equal — the two-key property then rests on one key.

fields.name: block_entry
docs: The hook `BlockEntry` PDA `["blocked", holder]` that justified it.

fields.name: blocked_by
docs: `BlockEntry.added_by` — the BlocklistAuthority key that blocked `holder`.

fields.name: admin
docs: The signing `Admin` of this program.

fields.name: custody_vault
docs: The `CustodyVault` (RedemptionQueue + BurnAndAttest) owning `destination`.

fields.name: kyc_gated
docs: The mint's restriction mode at seizure time (hook config).

types.name: ClaimRecord
docs: Tracks cumulative drawn for refund / investor-yield claims.
Seeds: `["pv_claim", payout_vault, [kind as u8], investor]`.

types.name: ClawbackReason
docs: Why a clawback was allowed — the holder's entry was revoked outright, or it
simply lapsed. Kept on the event so an audit can tell a sanction apart from
a paperwork expiry.

types.name: ConvertibleTargetSet
docs: Emitted by `set_convertible_to` — the share class's conversion target was
set (`Some`) or cleared (`None`).

types.name: CustodyDeposited
docs: Emitted by `deposit_to_custody_vault` — the beneficiary funded the escrow
with their own units; `total_deposited` is the ledger after the deposit.

types.name: CustodyRealized
docs: Emitted by `realize_custody_vault` with `BurnAndAttest` — the on-chain
attestation that the custodied tokens were consumed (e.g. equity converted).

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: The beneficiary whose KYC this realize checked (DeliveryEscrow);
default for every other type, even one that stored a beneficiary —
the event never names an unchecked beneficiary.

fields.name: kyc_registry
docs: The registry the beneficiary's KYC was checked in (DeliveryEscrow;
default otherwise).

types.name: CustodyReturned
docs: Emitted by `return_custody_vault` — the escrowed tokens of a
`DeliveryEscrow` vault were transferred back to the beneficiary
(tokens re-enter circulation — nothing is burned).

fields.name: withheld
docs: Units left in the escrow because they exceeded the deposit ledger and
the beneficiary could not pass receiver-KYC for the surplus.

fields.name: terminal
docs: False when `withheld > 0`: the vault stays open (state unchanged, escrow
marker alive) and a second return is possible. Consumers must not treat
this event as a transition to `Returned` unless this is true — the event
was emitted unconditionally before the split payout existed, so an
indexer keying off its mere presence would show the wrong state.

types.name: CustodyReverted
docs: Emitted by `revert_custody_vault` — the custodied tokens were returned
(v0.1: burned) after the vault's deadline passed without realization.

types.name: CustodyVault
docs: Generic custody escrow — the unifying mint → custody → burn primitive that
serves vesting, conversion and delivery. Seeds: `["custody", share_class, vault_id]`.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Token-2022 escrow account holding the custodied tokens; its authority is
this `CustodyVault` PDA.

fields.name: authority
docs: Who may `trigger` the vault.

fields.name: amount
docs: Expected custodied amount (informational; escrow balance is source of truth).

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix ts after which the vault may be reverted.

fields.name: metadata_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain agreement / conversion document.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Recipient of `return_custody_vault` (DeliveryEscrow only).
`Pubkey::default()` when unused.

fields.name: deposited
docs: **Deposit ledger** — the running total the beneficiary has put into this
escrow through `deposit_to_custody_vault` (the only instruction that
increments it). It is what makes `return_custody_vault`'s KYC exemption
evidence-based instead of assumed: a return of at most `deposited` is a
refund of the beneficiary's OWN units and needs no receiver KYC (a
lapsed passport must never strand a holder's deposit), while anything
beyond it did not come from the beneficiary — the only other way units
can land in the escrow is a raw `transfer_checked` from elsewhere (e.g.
freshly emitted treasury units) — and is released only to a receiver
whose `KycEntry` passes. Appended last so the account's existing byte
layout is unchanged up to `bump`.

fields.name: kyc_registry
docs: KYC registry pinned by `open_custody_vault` (DeliveryEscrow only;
`Pubkey::default()` otherwise). `realize_custody_vault` requires the
beneficiary's Approved, unexpired, jurisdiction-allowed `KycEntry` in
it. Appended last (v2, `CUSTODY_STATE_VERSION`): bytes 237..269.

types.name: Distribution
docs: A push-based pro-rata revenue distribution for a share class: the issuer
funds the escrow in one go and the program pays out holder-proportionate
batches computed off-chain from a holder snapshot.
Seeds: `["distribution", share_class, distribution_id]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin that created the distribution.

fields.name: funder
docs: Wallet that funded the escrow — `close_distribution` may only sweep the
remainder to a token account owned by it (and sends the escrow's rent
there too).

fields.name: mint
docs: Share-class Token-2022 mint the distribution relates to (indexing).

fields.name: payment_mint
docs: Payment mint being distributed (e.g. USDT).

fields.name: escrow
docs: Distribution-PDA-owned escrow holding the payment tokens.

fields.name: total_amount
docs: Total payment-token units funded for this distribution.

fields.name: snapshot_supply
docs: Share supply the off-chain pro-rata was computed against
(informational on-chain record).

fields.name: distributed_amount
docs: Cumulative payment-token units paid out so far.

fields.name: paid_count
docs: Cumulative number of payouts executed so far.

types.name: EscrowIdentity
docs: Escrow identity is distinct from the general escrow-routing exemption.
Same PDA seed as EscrowMarker, separate discriminator: inbound routing is
exempt, ordinary outbound delivery is screened. Only a recorded refund owner
can use the narrowly ledger-backed refund route; zero means no such route.

types.name: EscrowMarker
docs: Marks a registry-owned escrow authority PDA (OTC deal, offer, custody
vault or distribution). The `transfer_hook` program resolves
`["escrow_marker", token-account owner]` for both transfer legs and — when
the marker exists (owned by this program, non-empty) — exempts the leg from
the receiver-KYC checks in `KycGated` mode: the transfer is
platform-mediated (into or out of a program escrow), not wallet↔wallet.
Created alongside the escrow's parent account; closed on every terminal
path (settle / cancel / expire / realize / revert / return / close), rent
to the closing signer. Seeds: `["escrow_marker", owner_pda]`.

types.name: HolderApproved
docs: Emitted by `approve_holder` — a holder was approved, or re-approved after
a revoke / expiry (`reapproval` distinguishes the two).

fields.name: authority
docs: The registry authority that signed. The registry address no longer
implies the approver once the authority has rotated (2C-1).

types.name: HolderClawback
docs: Emitted by `clawback_from_holder` — a revoked / KYC-expired holder's units
were seized into a burn-only quarantine vault via the mint's permanent
delegate. `registry` is the registry the mint's hook config names (the
instruction pins it), so the trail cannot cite a throwaway registry.

fields.name: custody_vault
docs: The `CustodyVault` (RedemptionQueue) owning `destination`.

types.name: HolderRevoked
docs: Emitted by `revoke_holder`.

fields.name: authority
docs: The registry authority that signed (see `HolderApproved::authority`).

types.name: Issuer
docs: One per legal entity issuing assets. Seeds: `["issuer", legal_entity_id]`.

fields.name: legal_entity_id
docs: Client-supplied 32-byte legal-entity identifier (also the PDA seed).

fields.name: jurisdiction
docs: ISO-3166 numeric country code of incorporation.

fields.name: kyb_doc_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain KYB document bundle.

types.name: IssuerAuthorityChangeKind
docs: How `Issuer.authority` changed (carried by `IssuerAuthorityChanged`).

types.name: IssuerAuthorityChanged
docs: Emitted whenever `Issuer.authority` changes. `old_grant_closed` says whether
an `IssuerPermissions` record of the old authority was closed;
`capabilities_carried` is what the new authority's record now holds (0 when
no record was written).

types.name: IssuerAuthorityProposalCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_issuer_authority_transfer`.

types.name: IssuerAuthorityProposed
docs: Emitted by `propose_issuer_authority` (a re-proposal emits again).

types.name: IssuerPermissions
docs: An operational grant for one issuer authority; never confers global admin.
Seeds: ["issuer_permissions", issuer, authority].

types.name: IssuerRecovery
docs: A super-admin recovery of a LOST issuer authority key, effective only after
a 7-day timelock and cancellable by the current issuer authority (or the
super admin) meanwhile. Seeds: `["issuer_recovery", issuer]`.
⚠ Layout: the field order is fixed. Byte offsets: issuer 8,
current_authority 40, new_authority 72 (the same offset as
`AuthorityTransfer.new_authority`: the front lists both by a memcmp there),
proposed_by 104, proposed_at 136, eta 144, expires_at 152, version 160,
bump 161. Later fields are appended after `bump`.

fields.name: issuer
docs: Byte 8: the Issuer PDA.

fields.name: current_authority
docs: Byte 40: `issuer.authority` when proposed; execute requires it to still
be the live authority (a rotation in between makes the recovery stale).

fields.name: new_authority
docs: Byte 72: the only key that can execute (it signs).

fields.name: proposed_by
docs: Byte 104: the proposing super admin; execute requires it to still be
`platform.admin`. Receives every refund (this rent and the old grant's).

fields.name: proposed_at
docs: Byte 136.

fields.name: eta
docs: Byte 144: executable at or after this unix ts.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Byte 152: `eta + ISSUER_RECOVERY_EXECUTION_WINDOW`; executable strictly before it.

fields.name: version
docs: Byte 160: `STATE_VERSION`.

fields.name: bump
docs: Byte 161.

types.name: IssuerRecoveryCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_issuer_recovery`.

types.name: IssuerRecoveryProposed
docs: Emitted by `propose_issuer_recovery` (a re-proposal resets the timelock and
emits again).

types.name: JurisdictionRules
docs: Transfer-eligibility policy attached to an `Asset`.
**Informational only — NOT enforced on-chain.** No program reads these
fields when validating a transfer; actual enforcement is the
`transfer_hook` program's KYC registry (sanctions blocklist on every
transfer, plus the optional per-mint KYC-gated mode). This struct is a
declared policy record that off-chain tooling may display or act on.

fields.name: allowed_countries
docs: 1024-bit bitmap over ISO-3166 numeric country codes (bit N = country N).

fields.name: max_holders
docs: Maximum distinct holders; 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: restricted_period_end
docs: Unix ts until which only whitelist transfers are allowed; 0 = none.

fields.name: allow_p2p
docs: Whether peer-to-peer (non-launchpad / non-OTC) transfers are allowed.

types.name: KycEntry
docs: Per-holder KYC record. Seeds: `["kyc", registry, holder]`.

fields.name: accreditation_level
docs: 0 = retail, higher = accredited / qualified-investor tiers.

fields.name: expiry
docs: Unix ts after which the entry is stale and transfers to the holder fail.

fields.name: external_ref_hash
docs: SHA-256 reference to the off-chain KYC dossier.

types.name: KycRegistry
docs: KYC registry. docs/01 §9 Q1: the platform runs a global registry; an asset
may additionally point at a stricter per-issuer one via `extra_kyc_registry`.
Seeds: `["kyc_registry", creating authority]`. The address is permanent;
`authority` rotates via `propose_kyc_registry_authority` /
`accept_kyc_registry_authority`. Never re-derive the registry from
`authority` — take it by address (hook config, pinned front config).
`bump` keeps the bump of the ORIGINAL seeds and is no longer verified.

fields.name: authority
docs: KYC-provider multisig authorised to approve / revoke holders, rotate
this authority and replace the jurisdiction bitmaps.

types.name: KycRegistryAuthorityChanged
docs: Emitted by `accept_kyc_registry_authority` — the registry address is
unchanged; only its `authority` moved.

types.name: KycRegistryAuthorityProposalCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_kyc_registry_authority_transfer`.

types.name: KycRegistryAuthorityProposed
docs: Emitted by `propose_kyc_registry_authority` (a re-proposal overwrites the
pending one and emits again).

types.name: KycRegistryCreated
docs: Emitted by `create_kyc_registry`.

types.name: KycRegistryJurisdictionsUpdated
docs: Emitted by `update_kyc_registry_jurisdictions` — both bitmaps were replaced
whole (the new values are carried for audit).

types.name: MilestoneClaim
docs: Records a holder's claim against a milestone — prevents double-claiming.
Seeds: `["rt_claim", milestone, claimer]`.

types.name: Offer
docs: An OTC sell offer for share-class units. Seeds: `["offer", share_class, offer_id]`.
docs/05.

fields.name: mint
docs: Share-class Token-2022 mint being sold.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Offer-PDA-owned escrow holding the maker's deposited share units.

fields.name: payment_mint
docs: Payment mint the taker pays in.

fields.name: amount
docs: Share-class units offered.

fields.name: price
docs: Total price in payment-token base units.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix ts after which the offer can no longer be taken and anyone may
`expire_offer` it (escrow returns to the maker). 0 = never expires.

fields.name: deposited
docs: **Deposit ledger** — the running total the MAKER has put into this
offer's escrow through `deposit_to_offer_escrow` (the only instruction
that increments it). `create_offer` is permissionless and opens an EMPTY
escrow, and that escrow is an ordinary Token-2022 account anyone can
`transfer_checked` into, so "whatever sits in the escrow is the maker's"
is not a fact the chain knows — it has to be recorded. Every escrow→
wallet exit (`cancel_offer` / `expire_offer`) releases at most this much
without a receiver-KYC check, and `take_offer` refuses to sell units the
maker never deposited. Appended last so the existing byte layout up to
`bump` is unchanged.

types.name: OfferDeposited
docs: Emitted by `deposit_to_offer_escrow` — the maker funded their own offer;
`total_deposited` is the ledger after the deposit.

types.name: OtcDeal
docs: A bilateral (two-party) OTC escrow between a named buyer and seller.
The platform creates the deal after the parties agree off-chain; both
deposit, and once both escrows are funded the swap settles atomically.
If the deal expires (or an admin cancels) with only one side funded, the
deposit is refunded. Seeds: `["otc_deal", share_class, deal_id]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin that created the deal (also the signer of `cancel_otc_deal`).

fields.name: mint
docs: Share-class Token-2022 mint being sold.

fields.name: payment_mint
docs: Payment mint the buyer pays in.

fields.name: asset_escrow
docs: Deal-PDA-owned escrow holding the seller's deposited share units.

fields.name: payment_escrow
docs: Deal-PDA-owned escrow holding the buyer's deposited payment.

fields.name: amount
docs: Share-class units the seller deposits.

fields.name: price
docs: Total price in payment-token base units the buyer deposits.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix ts after which anyone may `expire_otc_deal` it (deposits are
refunded). 0 = never expires.

fields.name: asset_deposited_amount
docs: **Deposit ledger (asset leg)** — share units the SELLER actually moved
into `asset_escrow` through `deposit_otc_asset` (always exactly
`amount`; recorded rather than assumed). The refund paths cap the
KYC-free payout to the seller at this number: the escrow is an ordinary
token account, so anyone — including the admin who named both parties —
can raw-`transfer_checked` extra units into it, and sweeping the live
balance would hand those units to a wallet the chain never vetted.
Appended last so the existing byte layout up to `bump` is unchanged.

fields.name: payment_deposited_amount
docs: **Deposit ledger (payment leg)** — payment units the BUYER actually
moved into `payment_escrow` through `deposit_otc_payment` (always
exactly `price`). The payment mint carries no transfer hook, so this is
not a KYC control; it stops a refund from paying out value the buyer
never deposited.

types.name: PauseFlagsChanged
docs: Emitted by `set_pause_flags` and `set_pause` — the emergency-pause bitmask
changed from `old` to `new`, signed by `by`.

types.name: PayoutFounderSynced
docs: Emitted by `sync_payout_founder` when `PayoutVault.founder` actually changed.

types.name: PayoutVault
docs: Holds the proceeds (payment mint) of one sale and disburses them to the
founder. Seeds: `["payout", sale]`.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Payment-token escrow token account; authority = this vault PDA.

fields.name: founder
docs: Beneficiary (issuer authority).

fields.name: num_tranches
docs: = vesting_months - cliff_months. Capped at 255 (u8) — ~21 years, ample.

fields.name: vote_round
docs: Most recently opened vote round (v2); the first round is 1.

types.name: Platform
docs: Singleton. Seeds: `["platform"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: The super admin — the only key that may add or remove `Admin`s.

fields.name: pause_flags
docs: Bitmask of `PAUSE_*` (constants.rs); byte 74, formerly `paused: bool`.
0 and 1 keep their old meaning (1 = onboarding paused).

docs: An advisory governance proposal for a share class. Votes are weighted by a
holder snapshot (Merkle root); the outcome is signaling only — no on-chain
execution. Seeds: `["proposal", share_class, proposal_id]`. docs/01 §10.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin that created the proposal.

fields.name: metadata_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the off-chain proposal text.

fields.name: snapshot_slot

fields.name: snapshot_root
docs: Merkle root of the `(voter, weight)` snapshot.

types.name: ProtocolTreasuryChanged
docs: Emitted by `set_protocol_treasury` — the wallet whose token accounts
receive the protocol's share of routed yield changed.

types.name: RightsIssuance
docs: Links a Rights-Token share class to an underlying token that vests to its
holders through milestone Merkle claims. Seeds: `["rights", share_class,
issuance_id]`.

fields.name: share_class
docs: The Rights-Token share class whose holders are entitled to the underlying.

fields.name: underlying_mint
docs: The underlying token delivered at each milestone.

fields.name: escrow
docs: Escrow holding the underlying tokens; authority is this `RightsIssuance` PDA.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin that opened the issuance.

types.name: Sale
docs: A primary sale of a share class. Seeds: `["sale", share_class, sale_id]`.

fields.name: mint
docs: Share-class Token-2022 mint being sold.

fields.name: payment_mint
docs: Payment mint (e.g. USDC) buyers pay in.

fields.name: proceeds
docs: Escrow token account (payment mint) collecting proceeds.

fields.name: authority
docs: Issuer authority that opened the sale.

fields.name: price_per_unit
docs: Payment-token base units per one share-class unit.

fields.name: end_ts
docs: 0 = no end.

fields.name: raise_type
docs: Disbursement type, fixed at sale open (investors see it before buying).

fields.name: cliff_months
docs: Startup: months with no payout before first tranche.

fields.name: vesting_months
docs: Startup: total vesting horizon in months.

fields.name: sale_approval
docs: The `SaleApproval` that `open_sale` consumed (and closed).

fields.name: application_hash
docs: Copied from the approval: commitment to the reviewed application.

docs: An Admin's approval to open exactly one sale. Seeds:
`["sale_approval", share_class, sale_id LE]`. Consumed and closed by
`open_sale`, or closed by `revoke_sale_approval`; the rent always returns to
`approved_by`.

issuer launchpad lists its approvals with a memcmp at that offset) and
`approved_by` at 177 (an Admin's approvals, listed when the Admin is
removed). Later fields are appended after `version`.

fields.name: share_class
docs: Byte 8.

fields.name: sale_id
docs: Byte 40.

fields.name: issuer
docs: Byte 48: the `Issuer` PDA (not its authority), so an approval
survives an issuer authority rotation.

fields.name: max_gross_raise
docs: Payment-mint base units; `price_per_unit * total_for_sale` must not exceed it.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix ts; `open_sale` is refused after it.

fields.name: application_hash
docs: sha256 of the canonical reviewed-application snapshot (kept off-chain).

fields.name: approved_by
docs: The approving Admin; receives the rent on consume / revoke. `open_sale`
also requires this key to still hold its Admin record.

docs: Byte 211. The Startup payout schedule the sale must use exactly (the
reviewed application's terms); both 0 for a Mature raise.

fields.name: vesting_months

types.name: VestingDeposited
docs: Emitted by `deposit_to_vesting_escrow`.

types.name: VestingMilestone
docs: One vesting milestone — a pool of underlying tokens claimable against a
Rights-Token holder snapshot. Seeds: `["rt_milestone", issuance, index]`.

fields.name: merkle_root
docs: Merkle root of `(claimer, entitlement)` — the holder snapshot.

fields.name: amount_pool
docs: Total underlying claimable in this milestone.

fields.name: unlock_ts
docs: Claims open once `unix_timestamp >= unlock_ts`.

types.name: VestingPosition
docs: A recipient's position in a series — non-transferable by construction:
only the wallet currently recorded here can claim (Claim mode) or receive
(Push mode), and `recover_vesting_position` is the ONLY way that record
changes. Seeds: `["vesting_position", series, index]`.

fields.name: wallet
docs: Current recipient wallet — mutated only by recovery.

types.name: VestingPositionAdded
docs: Emitted by `add_vesting_position`.

types.name: VestingPositionRecovered
docs: Emitted by `recover_vesting_position`.

types.name: VestingReleased
docs: Emitted by `claim_vested` / `push_vested`.

types.name: VestingSeries
docs: A vesting series — one token, one schedule, N recipient positions.
Seeds: `["vesting_series", authority, series_id]`.

fields.name: authority
docs: The client wallet — approval / recovery / cancellation authority.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The token being vested (any SPL / Token-2022 mint).

fields.name: escrow
docs: Escrow token account holding the deposits; authority is this PDA.

fields.name: total_allocated
docs: Sum of all position allocations. Frozen when Draft is finalized to Active.

fields.name: deposited
docs: Deposit ledger — only `deposit_to_vesting_escrow` writes it.

fields.name: total_released
docs: Cumulative released to recipients (claims + pushes).

fields.name: approval_window_secs
docs: Approval-mode window (seconds) after which an un-approved vested
tranche becomes deliverable anyway. Fixed at creation; 0 in Auto mode.

fields.name: recovery_enabled
docs: Fixed forever at creation: the client may re-point a position to a
replacement wallet (same recipient, lost keys).

fields.name: cancellation_enabled
docs: Starts as chosen at creation; ON can be irrevocably turned OFF
(`disable_vesting_cancellation`), never the reverse.

fields.name: pre_cliff_bps
docs: % (bps of each allocation) recipients keep when cancelled before
anything vested. Fixed at creation; 0 = "recipient gets nothing".

fields.name: approved_mask
docs: Bitmask of client-approved tranches (Approval mode; bit i = tranche i).

fields.name: final_cumulative
docs: Vested cumulative frozen at cancellation (or the pre-cliff amount) —
the post-cancel entitlement basis.

fields.name: tranches
docs: The schedule — ascending `unlock_ts`, every `amount > 0`. The final
tranche's cumulative must equal `total_allocated` once all positions
are added (enforced at finalization, release and active cancellation).

types.name: VestingSeriesCancelled
docs: Emitted by `cancel_vesting_series`.

types.name: VestingSeriesCreated
docs: Emitted by `create_vesting_series`.

types.name: VestingSurplusWithdrawn
docs: Emitted by `withdraw_vesting_surplus`; all unpaid allocations stay reserved.

types.name: VestingTimingMode
docs: Timing mode — fixed at creation.

types.name: VestingTranche
docs: One schedule entry — `amount` units (across ALL positions, pro-rata to
each position's allocation) unlock at `unlock_ts`. The full schedule is
stored in the series account and is immutable after creation.

types.name: VestingTrancheApproved
docs: Emitted by `approve_vesting_tranche`.

types.name: VestingUnvestedWithdrawn
docs: Emitted by `withdraw_unvested`.

types.name: VoteRecord
docs: A holder's vote on a proposal — its existence prevents double-voting.
Seeds: `["vote", proposal, voter]`.

types.name: YieldPaid
docs: Emitted by `distribute_batch` once per payout.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Recipient payment-token account.
